description: Land Acquisition - Udathalawinna, Pathadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District, Nikagolla, Yatawatta D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple orders for taking possession of specific land parcels with detailed descriptions of boundaries, extents, and locations. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative actions, including acquisition notices and a correction notice for a land plan, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
